paper_title: Searching for solar axions using data from the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory
notes: Paper constrains the isovector axion-nucleon coupling |g3_aN|=|gan-gap|/2 via solar axion-induced deuteron dissociation in SNO. Excludes |g3_aN| between 2e-5 and 1e-3 GeV^-1 for axion masses up to ~5.5 MeV at 95% CL. The y-axis of Fig.1 is labeled in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling normalization), which is unusual for the dimensionless g_an enum convention; the primary quoted bound is on g3_aN (isovector), but is interpreted as a limit on gan (and gap) assuming no cancellation. Confidence reduced because coupling is isovector (neither purely neutron nor proton) and units are GeV^-1 rather than the dimensionless convention expected. Data points are exclusion band corners read from the constant lower bound (2e-5 GeV^-1) extending across masses up to ~5.5 MeV with an upper solar-trapping bound ~1e-3 GeV^-1.
